name: OANDA
verdict: Owned by FTMO, a Czech private company co-owned by its founders Otakar Šuffner and Marek Vašíček. Nothing found.
note: Rating none: no state in the owner chain and no human-rights finding against OANDA or FTMO located. OANDA's May 2025 settlement with the US National Futures Association was a financial-regulation matter, which METHOD.md excludes.
